clarity.label: Clarity, from your container
clarity.note: Animated example based on the template options. It does not load Clarity or send any information.

steps.title: Connect the project
steps.body: Add the template to GTM and enter your Clarity Project ID. Choose when the tag should fire.

steps.title: Mark what matters
steps.body: Send a custom event to locate a specific interaction across sessions, such as a demo request.

steps.title: Add context
steps.body: Custom tags help you filter sessions using implementation data, such as page type or experiment variant.

steps.title: Connect consent
steps.body: The template communicates analytics_storage and ad_storage states to Clarity through Consent V2 and listens for updates. Your CMP manages the user’s choice.

spy.label: From an identifier to its configuration
spy.note: ga4spy.com interface captured on October 27, 2026. It uses the tool’s own public “try with sample data” example.

steps.title: Start with an ID or URL
steps.body: Choose Web and enter a Measurement ID or URL. You can also explore the tool with its public sample.
steps.alt: GA4 Spy interface: Web tab, Measurement ID or URL field and sample-data link.

steps.title: Review what is configured
steps.body: The result organizes events, Google tag settings and other observable options. This example expands the key-event list; these are configuration values, not property results or user data.
steps.alt: GA4 Spy sample result with configuration sections and the key-event list expanded.

data.label: Find the field. Build the report.
data.note: data.ga4spy.com interface captured on October 27, 2026. The builder shows an illustrative ID; no GA4 report was opened or created.

steps.title: Search by name or identifier
steps.body: A search such as “session source” groups related fields. Filter by dimensions, metrics, categories and availability across GA4 surfaces.
steps.alt: GA4 Spy Cheatsheet search results for session source, organized by category.

steps.title: Check the scope
steps.body: The sessionSourceMedium entry shows its API name, session scope, explanation and capabilities. That context helps you choose the right field.
steps.alt: sessionSourceMedium details with description, Session scope and available capabilities.

steps.title: Build a report link
steps.body: Report Builder combines dimensions, metrics and filters into a GA4 URL. The report opens in your own session and requires the corresponding permissions.
steps.alt: Report Builder with sessionSourceMedium and sessions selected and a GA4 URL ready.
